item.title: Cyber Resilience at Machine Speed: Author John Kindervag and contributor Dr. Chase Cunningham. [Special Edition]
item.description: On this special edition podcast, Dave Bittner is joined by John Kindervag and Dr Chase Cunningham to discuss the principles of zero trust, cyber resilience, and how AI is transforming cybersecurity strategies. They explore practical frameworks, misconceptions, and the future of security in a machine-speed world. John is the author of "Cyber Resilience at Machine Speed: The Zero Trust Model for the AI Era﻿," and Chase is one of the book's contributors. Learn more about your ad choices... Feed: https://feeds.megaphone.fm/cyberwire-daily-podcast
